_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED AGAINST A LIVE CALENDAR RE-PULLED FOR 2026-08-25 THROUGH 2026-08-29, AND ALL THREE DUTIES ARE RECORDED AS PERFORMED RATHER THAN SKIPPED. NOTHING WAS REMOVED, because nothing on this file has passed: the single NVDA row is dated 2026-08-26 after the close, now ONE session ahead rather than two, and it was re-verified on this pull as NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet. THE ESTIMATE MOVED AND IT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED OVER: 2.09 for fiscal Q2 2027 on today's pull against the 2.07 this file carried from 8/24. A one-cent revision changes nothing about the refusal below, but a row that silently updates its own numbers is a row nobody can audit. THE CARRIED SPOT WAS REFRESHED FROM A LIVE QUOTE AND THIS TIME IT WENT THE OTHER WAY. 212.36 bid at 19:36:24.560886127Z against the 208.83 written here yesterday: UP 3.53, or 1.69%. Every previous refresh of this row moved it DOWN - 219.41 to 217.21 to 215.01 to 208.83 - so this is the first one that reversed, and cumulatively the row now sits 7.05 below where it was written on 8/21, 3.21%, having been 10.58 below it a day ago. The case for refreshing as a rule rather than when the drift looks worth the bother is exactly this: a row is not wrong in one direction, it is just stale, and yesterday's file would today centre its implied range three and a half dollars UNDER the tape after centring it six dollars OVER the tape the day before. EVERY BRANCH STILL CARRIES ITS WHY AND NO BRANCH TEXT IS CHANGED. The 8/25 to 8/27 span still covers both prints - NVDA 2026-08-26 pm and MRVL 2026-08-27 pm, re-verified, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027. No wording gap was found on this pull either. WHAT THIS SESSION ADDS IS THAT BRANCH THREE'S CONDITION INVERTED INSIDE A SINGLE SESSION, WHICH IS MORE INSTRUCTIVE THAN IT ARRIVING. Yesterday the whole complex sold off into the print together - NVDA -2.74%, AMD -3.76%, MRVL -3.39% - and branch three, written six sessions early, answered that a name looking cheap before a dated binary is the binary being priced rather than a setup. Today it rallied back just as hard: NVDA 212.36 bid and +1.86%, AMD 479.75 and +5.04%, MRVL 238.61 and +4.06%. So the condition branch three was written for lasted exactly one day. THAT MOVES THE TEST FROM BRANCH THREE TO BRANCH ONE, AND IT IS THE HARDER TEST. Refusing a complex that is falling costs nothing and feels like prudence. Refusing one that is ripping into its own print on the eve of the print is where the refusal actually gets paid for, and it holds UNCHANGED - because it never rested on a view about direction. The stop is the reason: an 8% stop cannot survive an event gap, up or down, and a sympathy name carries the index gap without carrying the index's liquidity. Nothing about a +5% AMD session makes that arithmetic different from a -3.76% one. AMD'S ARITHMETIC MOVED THE UNHELPFUL WAY AND IS NOW MORE PROHIBITIVE, NOT LESS: one share at 479.75 is 47.54% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling, UP from the 45.13% this row carried yesterday and from 46.74% on 8/21. AMD stays blocked by an explicit mechanical limit before any view about NVDA reaches it, and today's rally widened that block rather than narrowing it. IMPLIED MOVE STAYS NULL AND THE CHECK OWED TO THIS RUN IS DISCHARGED RATHER THAN SKIPPED. Yesterday's note assigned the 8/25 pre-close the straddle IF anything was open or contemplated by now. Nothing is open - both position lists returned empty on a live pull - and nothing is contemplated, because branch one refuses the entire complex through 8/27. Item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold, there is no hold to place it before, and a straddle quoted for a position nobody will take measures nothing. A number that was not pulled does not get written down as though it were. THE BOOK GOES INTO THE PRINT FLAT, WHICH IS THE OUTCOME THESE BRANCHES WERE WRITTEN SIX SESSIONS EARLY TO PRODUCE, AND IT IS NOW ACTUAL RATHER THAN ANTICIPATED. The 8/27 open owns pruning this row once the print is out; the 8/26 pre-close owns the same decision one day closer with the same answer already written down.

moves.source: Spot REFRESHED LIVE at 19:36:24.560886127Z on 8/25 by the pre-close run, not carried from the day the row was written: 212.36 bid / 212.37 ask on a 0.005% spread, last trade 212.365, against a 208.48 settled close on 8/24 - UP 1.86% on the session and UP 1.69% from the 208.83 this row carried from yesterday. That is the FIRST refresh of this row that moved it upward; the previous three all moved it down, by 2.20, 2.20 and 6.18. Cumulatively the row now sits 7.05 under the 219.41 it was written at on 8/21 - 3.21% - having been 10.58 under it a day ago. The event was re-verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-25 to 2026-08-29: NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, ONE session ahead. The estimate READ 2.09 for fiscal Q2 2027 on this pull against 2.07 on the 8/24 pull - a one-cent revision, recorded because a row that quietly updates its own numbers cannot be audited. impliedMove is null because NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED, and that is a discharged check rather than an outstanding one: this board holds nothing into the print, both position lists returned empty on a live pull, branch one refuses the whole complex through 8/27 so nothing is contemplated either, and item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold. MRVL is recorded here rather than as a second row: re-verified on the same pull as 2026-08-27 after the close, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027 - a second dated semiconductor print one session behind NVDA, and the reason branch one spans 8/25 to 8/27. It quotes 238.61 bid, UP 4.06% today. AMD is recorded here as the transmission mechanism rather than as a second row, and its arithmetic is now MORE prohibitive than yesterday: 479.75 bid at 19:36:24.788138314Z, UP 5.04% on the session, and one share is 47.54% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling - up from 45.13% yesterday. Today's rally widened the mechanical block rather than narrowing it. THE WHOLE COMPLEX REVERSED TOGETHER TODAY - NVDA +1.86%, AMD +5.04%, MRVL +4.06% - exactly inverting yesterday's joint sell-off. Branch three's condition therefore lasted one session, and the live test has moved to branch one, which is the harder one: refusing a complex that is ripping into its own print rather than one that is falling. It holds unchanged, because the reason was never directional - an 8% stop cannot survive an event gap either way.

branches.cond: An entry considered in the AI or semiconductor complex - AMD, SMCI, MRVL, or any sympathy name - on 8/25, 8/26 or 8/27, into either print
branches.act: Refused, decided now rather than on the day
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and for equity the -8% stop has to survive the event or it is not a stop. This board has already refused SMCI once on exactly that arithmetic - a 14.4% implied move swallows an 8% stop, so the realistic bad case gaps through the exit rather than filling at it. NVDA own move is not the exposure here; the exposure is that a sympathy name carries the index gap without carrying its liquidity, which is the 2026-08-10 finding about four names off one list being one position at four times the size. THE DATE RANGE WAS WIDENED ON 8/21 AND THE REASON IS RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED OVER. This branch originally read 8/25 or 8/26 and would have been silent on 8/27, when MRVL reports after the close - a second dated semiconductor print the row had not named. The extra day is not a new judgement and changes no arithmetic; the wording was under-inclusive and a live calendar pull found it. Two prints on consecutive evenings also means the complex carries event risk across BOTH nights, so a position opened on 8/26 to trade the NVDA reaction is holding into MRVL, which is the same refusal one day later rather than a clean second entry. Writing the refusal down six sessions early is the point: on 8/26 it would be a view about the report, and today it is a mechanical consequence of a stop that cannot hold.

branches.cond: A position from an unrelated setup is open and running into 8/26
branches.act: The 8/26 pre-close decides it explicitly against this row, and a hold through the print requires the straddle pulled first
branches.why: A name outside the complex is not automatically exposed, and this row must not become a reason to close good positions early on a date that has nothing to do with them. But an NVDA print is the one evening a session where correlation appears in names that showed none for a month, so the hold cannot be passive. Item 3 binds: no straddle pulled means no earnings hold, and that applies to a position held THROUGH the event even when the event belongs to another ticker whose gap it will wear.

branches.cond: The complex sells off into 8/26 and a name on this board looks cheap for it
branches.act: Not bought on that basis, and re-approached only from 8/27 on the reaction bar
branches.why: Cheapness ahead of a dated binary is not a setup - it is the binary being priced, and buying it is taking the event risk the branch above just refused. This is the same reasoning that has kept KLAR unbought through a 22% gap all day: the first print of a fall is not a support level. The post-print session is the first point the rulebook can engage at all, and item 2 then governs - the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is.
